messages:
alex: Heads-up: rolling out release v2.3.1 (ranker v2) in the 02:00-05:00 UTC change window. Will gate with feature flag `ff/ranker_v2`. Suggest conservative ramp — want quick alignment on numbers and rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: Deploy job started for release/v2.3.1 · canary -> us-west-2 · CI green · link: https://ci.internal/release/1812345678 · agent: deploy-bot

mira: +1 on conservative. Recommend start at 1% for 15m, then 5% for 20m, 20% for 30m, then 100% if all pass. Add automatic rollback on error-rate > 1.5x baseline for 10m or p95 latency increase > 30%.

sam: Agree. Also let's pin the model binary: `ranker_v2:2026-03-20-rc1` in the flag metadata so we don't roll different artifacts mid-ramp.

chris: Ops note — confirmed change window, but we only have one extra oncall. @mira can you own the first 40m watch? I'll be reachable for rollback ops.

alex: I'll draft release notes. Key items: latency improvement, rerank precision bump, no config changes expected. Also add an explicit 'kill-switch' we can hit to flip flag to control immediately.

mira: For the kill-switch use the traffic-split API and the experiment tag so it reverts cleanly:
```
# toggle to control immediately
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle \
  -d '{"flag":"ff/ranker_v2","percent":0,"reason":"emergency-kill"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FLAGS_TOKEN'
```

sam: I'm adding a short HealthCheck job in infra: checks = [error_rate, p95_latency, model_ver_match, tail_qps]. If any check fails for 2 consecutive windows we'll auto-revert and ping #incidents.

ops-bot: Canary metrics streaming -> http://metrics.internal/dash/1812345678 (refresh every 15s). Alerts: configured for error-rate and p95.

alex: Decision summary: ramp plan = 1% (15m) -> 5% (20m) -> 20% (30m) -> gradual to 100%. Rollback triggers = error >1.5x baseline for 10m OR p95 latency +30% OR model mismatch. Pin model version in flag metadata. Kill-switch command in ops runbook. @mira you watch first 40m, @chris you on rollback ops. I'll post release notes and update the deploy ticket. :thumbsup:
